physical_photo_actually_opened.observation: Oblique isolated metal manifold: open spigot with circumferential ribs, two-hole flanged base, small lateral projection; mating face/underside and metric section hidden.

observed: Two pierced ears on rounded cast flange
Continuous hollow collar with top annular mouth and three readable circumferential relief bands below the rim
Broad rounded root between plain lower neck and base flange
Short lateral cast feature, precise function unresolved
Cast surface and small illegible neck mark
unknowns: Opposing and reverse faces, all body dimensions, angle/clocking and exact RDC applicability
Whether lateral feature has an actual open/blind functional recess
Back groove, any original casting digits and installed tube routes
construction_order: Author rounded asymmetric base with actual mouth/bolt holes
Author annular neck directly hollow with curved root, three rounded bands and softened lip
Union hollow neck and bounded side boss to base, no majority-void cut or global bevel on thin result
Conditional unchanged insulator/head references, no O-ring or sleeve fabricated implicitly
Original estimated cast-grain material only if realized and checked in native buffers/maps

G3_iteration.rejection: Side feature too much like a rounded machined rectangular block against the short tapered cast feature in the single photograph.
G3_iteration.replacement: Closed authored oval sections, wider root and rounded tapered end; actual cross section, function and clocking remain estimates.
G3_iteration.first_material_stage_rejected_before_bak: Seven badly conditioned nativeUV/tangent faces, including six flat flange triangles and one tiny lug transition; source-local diagonal refinement required, no buffer repair.
